## 3. Exact remaining input for the bridge

To close `Cor312ToABCBridgeInterface` it suffices to construct, for the finite-place carrier
with `arithmeticTupleIQHullLogVolumeInterface`, a
`Cor312EpsilonArithmeticComparison hullData epsilon` for every `epsilon > 0`, i.e. to prove
  (Gap1) `height_le_normalizedRegionVolume` for the chosen comparison region, and
  (Gap2) `regionVolume_le_normalizedWeight` (with the normalized weight + hull + D).
Geometry supplies the IQHull instance, theta/signed certificates and conditional gap
reductions; the two gap proofs for all `epsilon` remain the open arithmetic content
(equivalent to ABC by the interface docstring).  The paper-normalized deficit files are
model-level normalized statements and do not construct this instance.
